name: @dsh-external/dsh-memory
description: Qoder-Agent-SDK-style persistent memory for DSH: a background generation pass writes knowledge into per-scope memory files after each turn, and a consumption pass loads them into Agent context on session start or explicit refresh. DSH 持久记忆插件：按 Qoder SDK 的做法分离「生成」与「消费」，user/project 双作用域，token 预算加载。

meta.title: Memory (Qoder-style)
meta.description: Persistent user/project memory modeled on the Qoder Agent SDK: a background pass records durable knowledge after each turn, and a budgeted pass loads it into context at session start.
